name: Atelier Studio Page
description: Full architecture studio landing page with a character-reveal hero, outlined about title, pixelated image reveals, a pinned team section and a footer, all driven by scroll and smooth scrolling.
contents: Hero with brand title, vision text, email button and index grid
Fixed header navigation with mobile menu overlay
About section with floating placeholders, info tiles and service cards
Projects grid with pixelated image reveals
Pinned team section with member cards
Footer with contact, office address, links and back to top
behavior: Smooth scrolling through Lenis with animated anchor navigation
Header hides on scroll down and returns on scroll up
Hero and footer titles reveal character by character
About title fills in from outline on scroll
Project images depixelate when scrolled into view
Pixel grid color transitions between sections on scroll
Team title is pinned while member cards scroll over it
Respects reduced motion by skipping animations and smooth scroll
editableByProps: All text, links, images, projects, services and team members
Background, text, dark section, accent and card colors

needsCodeEdit.where: loadFonts function and the anton constant
pixelGrid constant and the pixels function inside the useEffect

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Header and mobile menu are fixed to the viewport
Loads Anton and Kode Mono from Google Fonts at runtime
Includes a 600vh pinned team section to give the pin scroll room
Pixel transition grids at section edges use bgColor and darkColor so those must match the section colors
